## 📝 Description
Provide a brief summary of the changes and the motivation behind them.

## ✅ Checklist
- [ ] Code follows the project style guide
- [ ] Tests have been added or updated
- [ ] Documentation has been updated
- [ ] All new and existing tests passed

## 🚀 Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 🎨 Style/Refactor (non-functional changes)

## 🔗 Related Issues
Fixes #(issue number)

## 🔬 Reproduce-First Verification (required for auto-fix PRs)
- [ ] The claimed defect is proven by a failing test or reproduction script before the fix
- [ ] The reproduction fails on the base branch and passes after this change (test pair included)
- [ ] External API claims (library signatures, runtime behavior) were verified by installing the package and introspecting it (e.g. `inspect.signature`), not by static reasoning alone
- [ ] Diff paths are valid repository paths (no `a/tests/` style diff-prefix misroutes)
- [ ] No duplicate of an existing open/recently closed issue or PR (similarity checked)
